description: Object registry of the tactile pipeline (objects.py). Order = object id of the multi-object models. Coordinates: the STL file's own frame in mm (+x towards the head: tines / bowl / blade). Parts: names[k] covers x >= x_starts_mm[k] (decreasing starts); below the last start is the last name; |normal . z| < edge_nz is 'edge'.

conventions.object_frame: origin = the object's centre of mass (com_mm in the STL frame), axes = the STL axes; +x = the long axis towards the head (tines / blade tip / bowl), +z = the STL +z
conventions.table_frame: world W: table top z = 0, +z up (collect_dataset CONVENTIONS)
conventions.sensor_frame: S: x = image column, y = image row, z = into the object (down for a level sensor); left-handed in x-y as seen from above, because the image y points the other way than the world y
conventions.yaw: rotation of the object's +x axis about the vertical: in the table frame atan2(y, x) of +x projected on the table; the network predicts it in the sensor frame (atan2(row, col) of +x projected on the sensor x-y plane), 72 bins of 5 deg, bin k = [5k, 5k + 5) deg. Mirror symmetry about the long axis does not make yaw ambiguous; the 180 deg ambiguity is only about which side the head is on
conventions.stable_pose: the object's own stable-pose ids (dataset_multi/poses/<name>/stable_poses.json; fork_stl: dataset_mini/poses); only natural poses are sampled. Full pose = (object, centre x, y, yaw, stable-pose id)
conventions.indistinguishable_pose_pairs: poses that occupy the same space: fork2_stl 0 / 1 and spoon_stl 0 / 1 (flat, mirror-symmetric about the long axis and the mid-plane: face up = face down turned 180 deg about x), spoon_stl 2 / 3 (standing on either edge); ADD-S is reported for them
conventions.label_check: results_multi/data_check/pose_label_check.py: CAD outline at the labelled pose vs the depth, 30 presses per object (looked at); yaw label vs the image axis before / after augmentation
